findings: A nodular pancreatic cancer measuring 9 mm is observed in the tail of the pancreas. No local invasion factors are identified. There are no findings suggestive of lymph node metastasis. Multiple nodular shadows are observed in both lungs, raising suspicion of multiple lung metastases.
